query.description: Spec 화면: Device 의 공정 목록 (업로드된 파일 + Spec + 등록 Parameter 가 있는 공정)
query.commandtext: SELECT TEST_PROGRAM FROM TQP_GDS_SRC_FILE WHERE FACTORY = :f1 AND DEVICE_ID = :d1 UNION SELECT TEST_PROGRAM FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :f2 AND DEVICE_ID = :d2 UNION SELECT TEST_PROGRAM FROM TQP_GDS_ET_ITEM WHERE FACTORY = :f3 AND DEVICE_ID = :d3 AND TEST_PROGRAM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT ITEM_NAME, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, UNIT, ENABLE_FLAG, SPEC_TEXT, REMARK FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program ORDER BY ITEM_NAME

query.description: Spec 저장 (있으면 수정 / 없으면 추가, InsertExecuteMultiple). ITEM_NAME = 등록 Parameter 저장 이름
query.commandtext: MERGE INTO TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT T USING (SELECT :factory AS FACTORY, :device_id AS DEVICE_ID, :test_program AS TEST_PROGRAM, :item_name AS ITEM_NAME, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:lower_limit) AS LOWER_LIMIT, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:upper_limit) AS UPPER_LIMIT, :unit AS UNIT, :enable_flag AS ENABLE_FLAG, :spec_text AS SPEC_TEXT, :remark AS REMARK, :update_user AS UPDATE_USER FROM DUAL) S ON (T.FACTORY = S.FACTORY AND T.DEVICE_ID = S.DEVICE_ID AND T.TEST_PROGRAM = S.TEST_PROGRAM AND T.ITEM_NAME = S.ITEM_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.LOWER_LIMIT = S.LOWER_LIMIT, T.UPPER_LIMIT = S.UPPER_LIMIT, T.UNIT = S.UNIT, T.ENABLE_FLAG = S.ENABLE_FLAG, T.SPEC_TEXT = S.SPEC_TEXT, T.REMARK = S.REMARK, T.UPDATE_USER = S.UPDATE_USER, T.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, TEST_PROGRAM, ITEM_NAME, LOWER_LIMIT, UPPER_LIMIT, UNIT, ENABLE_FLAG, SPEC_TEXT, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) VALUES (S.FACTORY, S.DEVICE_ID, S.TEST_PROGRAM, S.ITEM_NAME, S.LOWER_LIMIT, S.UPPER_LIMIT, S.UNIT, S.ENABLE_FLAG, S.SPEC_TEXT, S.REMARK, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE, S.UPDATE_USER, SYSDATE)

query.description: Spec 1행 삭제 (그 Parameter 는 판정하지 않음)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_ET_LIMIT WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND TEST_PROGRAM = :test_program AND ITEM_NAME = :item_name
